producer_manifest.conditionPolicy: No time snapshot; applicable unsupported conditions rejected.
producer_manifest.scope: Static foot/bicycle graph composed with explicit outdoor document; supplied DEM/contours/administration packed by SDK. No raster conversion.
producer_manifest.attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors; source licensing and attribution remain required.

scope: Center-produced static foot graph, node endpoints, zero ascent penalty, cold library caches per query. Counts include package open/graph initialization; terrain sections may be present but are not queried by this benchmark.
ram_scope: Configured live library workspace/readers/cursor/label/queue/output payload, actual host sizeof; excludes allocator metadata, file adapter, query input and task stack. Not MCU peak.
limitations: Eight sampled node-endpoint queries; no proof of climb-weighted routing or raster/contour/administration performance or conditional-rule coverage. Desktop filesystem cache affects latency. No board/SD power measurements.
